summary: Wallet ESCROW at CONFIRM + 24h hold + QR consegna verificata — 7/8 pytest scenarios pass. FOUND one BUG: driver auto-confirm path (direct target + listino-price accept) skips we.hold, so client wallet is NOT blocked and the completed corsa releases €0 (escrow undefined). All other flows (pulizie QR-off/QR-on, insufficient_wallet 400, cancel refund, listino business order QR-off & QR-on, auto-release after past deadline) work end-to-end against live preview URL. Client wallet restored to seed (500 + 50 bonus) after run.

critical.issue: When a client sends a DIRECT driver richiesta (target_provider_id) and the provider accepts at listino price, the code auto-confirms (stato=confermata) but NEVER calls wallet_escrow.hold(). Consequence: escrow sub-doc is not created, client wallet_balance/bonus are not decremented, and later /complete calls we.release_richiesta which returns 0 because escrow.stato != 'held'. Earner receives NOTHING. The regular POST /api/driver/richieste/{rid}/confirm path DOES call we.hold correctly. Fix: in routers/driver.py lines 464-476 (is_direct && !has_counter branch) call `await we.hold(r, prezzo, f"Blocco garanzia corsa €{prezzo:.2f}")` before the $set update (mirror the confirm() handler line 503).

minor.issue: test_credentials.md advertises req-prov-token as the 'pulizie provider impresa' whose earnings should land in pending_balance + wallet_holds (24h). In reality req-prov-token → user_2f996c8a010a which has role='business' (same user as biz-test-token-999), so the escrow engine correctly credits wallet_balance IMMEDIATELY and creates no wallet_holds. Code is correct; test doc is misleading. Consider spinning a separate role='provider' impresa test user (e.g. lf-prov-token but with binario impresa listino, or a new one) if the doc's promise of provider-side 24h hold on impresa flow is required.

rca_of_issue: RCA — Driver auto-confirm escrow bug: routers/driver.py has TWO code paths that transition a driver richiesta to 'confermata'. Path A: POST /driver/richieste/{rid}/confirm (line 489) — calls we.hold(r, prop['prezzo'], ...) → escrow.stato='held'. Path B: POST /driver/richieste/{rid}/propose {accept:true} on a direct target (is_direct && !has_counter, line 464) — inlines the same $set update but WITHOUT calling we.hold. This is a copy-paste oversight introduced when auto-confirm was added: the author reproduced the stato/prezzo_finale/pagamento fields but not the hold. Reproduction: (1) client POST /driver/richieste {..., target_provider_id: prov_X}; (2) provider POST /driver/richieste/{rid}/propose {accept:true} at listino price → response includes {auto_confirmed:true}; (3) DB: richieste doc has stato='confermata' but no escrow field; client wallet unchanged; (4) provider POST /depart+/complete → arm_or_release_richiesta short-circuits because escrow.stato is undefined; earner receives nothing. Fix (one line): add `await we.hold(r, prezzo, f'Blocco garanzia corsa €{prezzo:.2f}')` before the $set in the auto-confirm branch, then optionally include the returned escrow in the update. Guarding: also add a defensive check in complete() to ensure escrow.stato=='held' before crediting, so a missing hold surfaces as a 400 rather than a silent no-op.
